description: This file contains helper functions for React Fast Refresh integration, including export registration, boundary detection, signature comparison, and update scheduling, with references to React Refresh runtime and module hot status.

methods.name: isSafeExport
methods.description: Checks if an export key is considered safe and should not be registered for React Refresh.

methods.name: registerExportsForReactRefresh
methods.description: Registers module exports with React Refresh runtime, skipping safe exports.

methods.name: isReactRefreshBoundary
methods.description: Determines if a module's exports form a React Refresh boundary, typically if they are React components.

methods.name: shouldInvalidateReactRefreshBoundary
methods.description: Compares previous and next module exports signatures to decide if the React Refresh boundary should be invalidated.

methods.name: getRefreshBoundarySignature
methods.description: Generates a signature array representing the module's export structure for boundary comparison.

methods.name: scheduleUpdate
methods.description: Schedules a React Fast Refresh update, retrying if the module hot status is not idle.
